text.en: Clients emphasize the heartfelt compassion shown toward both dogs and cats at this Little Portugal clinic. Reviewers note that Dr. Dayed and his staff handle nervous animals with remarkable patience, creating a calm atmosphere that puts pets at ease. Pet parents of senior animals particularly appreciate the dignity and warmth provided during difficult health moments.

Pet owners describe Dr. Dayed and his veterinary team as exceptionally honest, skilled, and dedicated to client service. Reviewers appreciate that the clinic discusses necessary treatment options straightforwardly without pushing unnecessary procedures or upselling. Clients also admire the doctor's community contributions, including surgical care for local rescue cats.

Reviewers report dependable medical relief for companion pets, noting that sick or distressed animals recover noticeably after clinic appointments. Pet owners value the clinic's ability to accommodate urgent cases and coordinate specialized care when required. Clients express deep gratitude for long-term health improvements achieved across years of regular veterinary care.

q.en: How does Dr. Dayed handle nervous or anxious animals?

a.en: Reviewers highlight that Dr. Dayed and his staff maintain a calm environment and use gentle handling that helps anxious pets feel comfortable.

q.en: Are emergency visits accommodated during regular operating hours?

a.en: Yes, clients note that the clinic makes every effort to fit in pets requiring urgent attention, even on busy days.

q.en: Does Dundas Dovercourt Animal Hospital provide in-house diagnostics?

a.en: The hospital is equipped for digital radiography and in-house laboratory blood testing to assist with clinical evaluations.

q.en: Does the clinic practice aggressive upselling for veterinary treatments?

a.en: No, pet owners praise the clinic for honest recommendations, fair discussions of treatment options, and a complete absence of upselling.
